newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa Cargo names sales planning VP.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa Cargo names sales planning VP.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo AG has appointed Wolfgang Schmitz as senior vice president sales planning and management.
He will be responsible from April 1 for worldwide co-ordination of sales activities under the new board member for sales and marketing, Stefan Lauer, a spokeswoman said.
Schmitz is currently passenger sales manager for parent company Deutsche Lufthansa AG and previously held senior positions in Lufthansa cargo sales.
